provenance: adapted: BMC Medicine submission-guidelines, span read back through fingerprint_for in the §11 D192 run. Public page.
note: §11 D192's AFTER row. The span the checklist shows a reader.

blocks.heading: Availability of data and materials
blocks.text: For all manuscripts, information about data availability should be detailed in an 'Availability of data and materials' section.

provenance: hand-written, the canonical word-limit phrasing used across guidelines.rs fixtures
note: The simplest true case. If this fails, nothing downstream is measurable.

blocks.heading: Author guidelines
blocks.text: Manuscripts must not exceed 3000 words. A structured abstract is required.

provenance: adapted: AIChE Journal author guidelines, span from the §11 D193 sample run. Public page.
note: An abstract limit stated in words rather than digits-first.

blocks.heading: Abstract
blocks.text: The abstract should state the objective and conclusions of the research concisely in no more than 150 words.

provenance: adapted: Biochemical and Biophysical Research Communications, span from the §11 D193 sample run.
note: A reporting standard bound to a study design, which is the kind that must NOT be read as single-valued (§11 D161).

blocks.heading: Ethics
blocks.text: All animal experiments should comply with the ARRIVE (Animal Research: Reporting of In Vivo Experiments) guidelines or the national equivalent.

provenance: adapted: a publisher's paid author-services page, quoted in CLAUDE.md's span entry. Ellipsis closed to a full sentence; the clause quoted is verbatim.
note: §11 D163. This produced word_limit = 12000 — a price list from a translation service read as a submission limit. Expected ABSENCE.

blocks.heading: Translation services
blocks.text: Features: Translation by a native Chinese speaker with an advanced degree, covering manuscripts of up to 12000 words.

provenance: adapted: a publisher's re-use licence text, quoted in CLAUDE.md's span entry. Ellipsis closed; the clause quoted is verbatim.
note: §11 D163. This produced word_limit = 100 — a text-mining quota, not a manuscript limit. Expected ABSENCE.

blocks.heading: Text and data mining
blocks.text: In the case of text-mining, individual words, concepts and quotes up to 100 words per matching sentence may be reused.

provenance: hand-written, modelled on the British Journal of Surgery row in §11 D194. The real span was truncated at 160 characters by the probe that printed it, and a truncated span is not a span, so it is reconstructed in the same shape rather than quoted.
note: §11 D194. The only lexicon-tier extraction in the 20-journal sample and the only false requirement among 46: a research article's abstract on a journal landing page, read as the journal's reporting standard. Expected ABSENCE.

blocks.heading: Latest articles
blocks.text: A PROSPERO-registered, PRISMA-compliant meta-analysis was conducted on clinical and patient-reported outcomes of immediate versus delayed reconstruction.

provenance: adapted: a real guideline page, quoted in the journal_extract negation-guard entry.
note: A sentence saying a section must NOT be used for something is not a requirement to include it. Expected ABSENCE.

blocks.heading: Acknowledgements
blocks.text: The section should also not be used to declare competing interests.

provenance: adapted: Nature Medicine's browser banner, quoted verbatim in guidelines.rs's page-gate fixtures.
note: §11 D159. Navigation chrome that appears on every page of a publisher's site. Expected ABSENCE.
